subject: literacy
concept: Rereading a familiar passage to build automaticity and smoothness
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading repeated-reading fluency principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student reads the same short passage three times, noticing it gets smoother and faster each time
exercise.pictorial: Student tracks their own reading smoothness across the three attempts using a simple visual scale
exercise.abstract: Student reads a passage on the first attempt and compares it to their third attempt

assessment.mastery_threshold: demonstrates measurable improvement in smoothness/pace between attempt 1 and attempt 3
misconception_flags: shows no improvement across repeated readings, suggesting decoding rather than fluency is still the bottleneck

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
next_node_on_fail: LITERACY.P1.FLUENCY.05R (remediation, routes back toward decoding support if bottleneck is accuracy, not fluency)
